usedFor: Webinargeek holds your webinar viewers and Slack is where the team hears, so “New Live Viewer” runs “Message Private Channel”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Live Viewer” in Webinargeek, then “Message Private Channel” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team gets a private channel message once someone watches a live or automated session.

watchOut: “New Live Viewer” is polling and fires after the scheduled time, and a Slack post waits for approval.
